data.name: Dominic
data.gender_notes: Dominic is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Of the Lord; belonging to God
data.long_meaning: From the Latin dominus, 'lord' — 'belonging to the Lord'. Its root is Latin dominus. Saint Dominic, founder of the Dominicans. Dominic is a Latin name meaning “Of the Lord; belonging to God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dominic expresses “Of the Lord; belonging to God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin dominus, 'lord' — 'belonging to the Lord'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dominic total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
